environment.description: Deployed as a container on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (internet-facing). The ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to the target group on port 8080. No additional middleware or filtering is applied. The container runs with the default ECS task execution role. The SQLite database is stored on an EFS mount at /var/data/. The ALB has a single listener rule: forward all requests matching path pattern /api/* to the target group.

config.ecs_task: fargate, 512MB, no additional security groups beyond ALB ingress
